scope.summary: Add the cloud-ci friction-accounting meta-gate: every friction-ledger row must terminate in a gate, an automation, or an explicit accepted-risk entry, with verifiable closure evidence. Born pack-shaped (policy is DATA), standalone born-blocking buck2 self-test with its own reviewed shrink-only baseline.
explicit_non_claims: No production branch protection, external infrastructure, or credentials are changed.
No friction-ledger row is edited; the ledger is read-only input to the gate.
No generated JSON face is hand-edited; generated faces are materialized only by infra/ci/materialize-cloud-ci-generated-faces.sh.

The gate is NOT registered through the central producer firewall baseline: the producer's RawCorpusCollector dispatch is hardwired to brand-residue, so the gate owns its own committed baseline and runs as a standalone born-blocking self-test (the rust-first-automation-hygiene precedent).
Existing legacy ledger debt (4 missing-field, 3 no-disposition, 2 closed-without-evidence, 7 accepted-risk-without-evidence keys) is frozen as reviewed shrink-only baseline, not remediated wholesale.

facets.F1_correctness: The pure evaluate_keyed folds event-sourced append rows onto each friction id (effective status = latest status_update else primary status; evidence/disposition present on any row) and emits Finding{code,key,detail} for schema, disposition, taxonomy, and closure-integrity violations.
facets.F2_tests: 14 unit tests (folding, each code in isolation, taxonomy prefix matching, evaluate==bare-projection, append-not-duplicate) plus 8 integration tests (live-repo contract + 6 RED fixtures proving each violation class fails closed and the shrink-only baseline breaks on growth).
facets.F3_maintainability: The concern is isolated to one gate crate plus one ADR/catalog/changelog entry and one workflow matrix line; all repo-specifics are DATA in friction-accounting-policy.json.
facets.F4_compatibility: Additive; no existing gate, face, or violation code changes. The central producer/firewall registry is intentionally untouched.
facets.F5_security: No credentials, network calls, or unsafe Rust; production code is #![forbid(unsafe_code)] with no unwrap/expect/panic. The ledger is read as DATA, never executed.
facets.F6_privacy: The gate reads the friction ledger text only; no tenant, user, or personal data processing.
facets.F7_operability: Each finding carries a human detail string naming the missing field/evidence/disposition; remediation is to add the evidence/field, never to grow the baseline.
facets.F8_performance: Single read of one JSONL file plus an O(rows) fold; no Cargo invocation, no network call.
facets.F9_compliance: ADR-0544 records the CI governance decision; the gate catalog and changelog are updated; the audit chain is appended.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of the additive gate crate, the workflow matrix line, and the docs.
facets.F11_observability: The live-repo gate test prints the row count and per-code legacy debt counts and asserts the frozen-empty codes are empty and the shrink-only codes equal the committed baseline exactly.
facets.F13_migration: Converts the previously ungoverned append-only friction ledger into a closed-loop accounted surface (SRE postmortem action-item model) without a breaking schema migration of the existing free-text statuses.

verification_plan: cargo metadata --format-version=1 >/dev/null -- PASS (Cargo.lock refreshed with the new package; sole sanctioned cargo exception)
buck2 test //cloud/cloud-ci/gates/oya-cloud-ci-friction-accounting-app:oya-cloud-ci-friction-accounting-app-unittest -- PASS 16 tests (post adversarial-review orphan-evasion fix)

buck2 test //cloud/cloud-ci/gates/oya-cloud-ci-friction-accounting-app:oya-cloud-ci-friction-accounting-app-gate -- PASS 10 tests (live-repo green + RED fixtures incl. orphan-update + real anti-laundering)
buck2 test //cloud/cloud-ci/... -- PASS 38, Fail 0 (faces byte-equal; registration + no-regression) before push
infra/ci/materialize-cloud-ci-generated-faces.sh . -- settle generated faces (decision-crosswalk picks up ADR-0544)
known_gaps: Remote oya-ci-required/cloud-ci context is pending until push and PR creation.
Reviewer approval and merge-queue admission remain pending.

Central producer firewall integration is deferred: generalizing the RawCorpusCollector dispatch to support multiple raw-corpus collectors is a follow-up so this gate can route through gate-baseline.generated.json instead of its own committed baseline.

The status taxonomy must be extended (one DATA edit) when the ledger introduces a genuinely new disposition vocabulary; until then a new status fails closed as friction_unknown_status (a deliberate forcing function).
